title: Free adult health check-up
what: A free health check under your health insurance. The set of tests depends on your age and sex.
why: For adults by age: usually once every three years until 40 and every year after 40. Check with your own clinic.
duration: the first stage usually takes 1 to 2 visits of 1 to 3 hours, with results in a few days
tell_doctor: Which illnesses you have and which medicines you take
Whether you smoke and how often you drink alcohol
Heart disease and cancer in close relatives

prepare.title: Booking
prepare.text: Book at the clinic where you are registered, or through an online portal.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: For a blood test, people usually come in the morning on an empty stomach. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Stool test
prepare.text: If a test for hidden blood is ordered, you will be given a container beforehand and told how to collect it.

bring: Your insurance or social security number, if the clinic asks
Results of tests from the last year, if you had any
steps: You fill in a health questionnaire
Your height, weight, blood pressure, and waist are measured
An ECG and chest X-ray are done, if it is due
The doctor sums up and says whether a second stage is needed
feel: The blood test is a short prick
after: You get a health record or a report
If something is found, you are sent for a second stage or to a specialist
Come for your next check-up on schedule

faq.q: Do I need to take time off work for the check-up?
faq.a: An employee may get a paid day for the check-up. Ask your employer.

faq.q: Can I do it on a weekend?
faq.a: Many clinics see patients on Saturdays. Ask your own.

reminders.text: Health check-up tomorrow. Do not eat in the morning before the blood test, and bring your ID and insurance card.
